tools.name: peek_dlq_messages
tools.description: Non-destructive peek at dead-letter queue messages for evidence gathering.

tools.name: query_application_logs
tools.description: Runs a KQL query against Application Insights for correlated error traces.

tools.name: search_similar_patterns
tools.description: Finds previously recorded incident patterns similar to the current error signature, scoped by tenantId.

tools.name: check_dlq_depth
tools.description: Returns active/dead-letter/total message counts for a queue, used to confirm repair outcome.

tools.name: query_erp
tools.description: Queries the ERP system to confirm the business record reached the expected state.

tools.name: replay_messages
usedBy: repair-agent (deterministic .NET code only, not a Prompt Agent)
tools.description: Replays dead-letter messages back onto the main queue. Only called after policy approval — see RepairPolicyEngine.cs.

tools.name: upsert_pattern
tools.description: Records a learned incident pattern (root cause + repair outcome) for future similarity search.
